description: Dept. of Co-operative Development - Cancelation of Liquidatary- Central Province Co-operative Societies
categorisation: The gazette content concerns the cancellation of liquidation for multiple co-operative societies. This falls under business/commercial matters as it deals with the administrative status of registered business entities (co-operative societies), their deregistration from liquidation, and involves the Registrar of Co-operative Societies. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land, legal frameworks, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other specialized categories, making Commercial (Type 6) the appropriate classification.
